name: opencode-repo-rewrite-v9-inih-real-reliable
description: Real upstream benhoyt/inih C→Rust port fixture under v7.2 reliability scaffolding. Handler-style subset + C oracle goldens. Frozen tests; inject PORTING/README; force-edit; staged milestones; skip-green; polish 2×900; wall 3600.

cases.prompt:
Rewrite/port the real upstream C inih library under source/upstream/ into the Rust crate under rust/.

This is a REAL upstream subset (benhoyt/inih) — NOT the Python toy ini_mini, and NOT a claim of full inih parity. Match source/README.md quirk contract, PORTING.md API map, and source/golden/*.events from the C oracle.

Implement parse_string → ParseOutcome { events, error_line }, Event { section, name, value }, and Ini { parse, get last-wins, has_section, sections, events, error_line } so milestone tests pass.

Critical contracts (inih defaults):
- Keys before any [section] → section "" (empty string), NOT "DEFAULT"
- Section names are NOT trimmed: [ section 2 ] → " section 2 "
- Comments: start-of-line ;# ; inline ; only after whitespace; # is NOT inline
- name=value and name:value; multiline = leading-whitespace continuation → separate events
- Duplicate keys: multiple events; get() last-wins; error_line keeps first error; keep parsing
- UTF-8 BOM allowed at start

Requirements:
- Work in rust/src/lib.rs (std-only preferred). Do NOT edit, weaken, delete, or skip anything under rust/tests/.
- Leave source/ intact (upstream + oracle + goldens).
- Suggested order: m01_ → m02_ → m03_ → m04_ → m05_ → m06_ → m07_ → m08_. Run `cargo test m01_`, then m02_, … from rust/.
- Work only inside this workdir.
